root.label: Israel expels UK from Gaza coordination centre and bars lawmakers

events.label: Israel expels UK from Gaza coordination centre and bars lawmakers

slots.name: lawmakers barred from entry
slots.sentence: In addition to the consulate closure order, Israel expelled the UK from the Washington-led coordination centre for post-war Gaza and barred 11 lawmakers from entering Israel, including former Labour Party leader Jeremy Corbyn and Zarah Sultana.
